content.title: Rezolute (RZLT) Is Down 82.7% After Phase 3 sunRIZE Failure in Congenital Hyperinsulinism Trial
content.summary: Rezolute recently reported that its Phase 3 sunRIZE trial of ersodetug in congenital hyperinsulinism failed to meet its primary and key secondary endpoints, with hypoglycemia reductions similar to placebo and some hypersensitivity reactions observed. Despite the setback, Rezolute plans to discuss a potential path forward with the FDA under ersodetug’s Breakthrough Therapy Designation while continuing the separate Phase 3 upLIFT study in tumor hyperinsulinism.
